title: To-dos saved under the react-todos key
summary: Each added to-do is saved as a JSON array under the localStorage key "react-todos".
what_differs: The broken page renders the list but never writes anything to localStorage.
steps: Type "milk" into the "What needs to be done?" box and press Enter. Type "eggs" into the same box and press Enter.

wordings.text: Verify the browser localStorage key "react-todos" holds exactly 2 todos.
Verify that the localStorage value stored under the key "react-todos" is a list containing "milk" and "eggs".
